posts.text: I welcome the understanding reached between the US and Iran on ending the West Asia conflict, which has caused serious economic disruption across the world and led to loss of life in many countries. We look forward to deliberations on the remaining issues. India has always stood for dialogue and diplomacy.

posts.text: Today's world is more inter-connected and inter-dependent than ever before. The energy security, food security, health security, cyber security and economic prosperity of any nation are not determined within its borders alone. Mobility, data, capital and technology — all of these bind us together: PM @narendramodi at the G7 Outreach Session in Evian, France.

posts.text: For decades, the retrograde Maoist ideology ruined the future of countless youngsters and held back the development of several regions. In the last decade, our government has worked to uproot this menace while ensuring the fruits of development reach every Naxal-affected area. We will keep working for peace and prosperity for all.

posts.text: Just days after three Indian sailors were killed in American attacks, there is neither regret nor apology. On the contrary, the US continues to issue orders. A sovereign nation would never tolerate such language. But our compromised PM? Silent. He listens like an obedient servant and complies with the orders. India's honour must be defended with clarity and resolve.

posts.text: Heeding Hon'ble PM Shri @narendramodi ji's appeal for austerity amid the West Asia crisis, I have directed a 50% cut in the convoys of the Chief Minister and ministers with immediate effect. I urge every citizen of Uttar Pradesh to conserve fuel, prefer public transport, and observe a weekly 'No Vehicle Day'. Small steps by all of us will strengthen the nation.

posts.text: When nothing was found in raids on many of our leaders, today the ED has arrived to raid scores of our small grassroots workers across the country. These people are cowards, they are spineless. They consider it bravery to raid ordinary citizens after humiliating the country before Trump in front of the whole world. To all my workers — stay strong, the truth is on our side.

posts.text: Spoke to US Secretary of State Marco Rubio this evening. I reiterated India's strong protest at the attacks by the US Navy in the Gulf that killed three Indian mariners. Such lethal actions against commercial shipping are not justified.

posts.text: The withholding tax treatment we have offered will be the first step towards drawing foreign capital back. That is not the end of the story — there will be more. We recognise we need more foreign capital to come in. Quarter after quarter, year after year, India remains the fastest growing economy, and we are taking a calibrated approach so the markets see the value.

posts.text: The matters related to our US legal proceedings are now behind us, allowing us to focus with renewed confidence and belief on the next phase of our growth. While others debated, the Group built. The next wave of AI will demand enormous investment in power, networks, data centres and logistics — because before AI can think, energy must flow.

posts.text: I am happy to note that we are advancing steadily towards the listing of Jio Platforms. Jio is making all arrangements to file for its IPO — this will mark a defining milestone in its journey. Jio and Retail have emerged as the real stars of Reliance, and we remain committed to building world-class digital and new-energy capabilities, first for India and then for the world.

posts.text: I don't believe in taking the right decisions. I take decisions and then make them right. Ups and downs in life are very important to keep us going, because a straight line even in an ECG means we are not alive.

posts.text: My warm greetings to all my fellow citizens, particularly the people of Odisha, on the auspicious occasion of Raja. This welcoming festival of the monsoon season is celebrated to honour the earth, motherhood and the clouds, reflecting the deep bond between nature and society. May the spirit of Raja inspire us to live in harmony with nature and dedicate ourselves to nation-building.
